description: Create a cryptographic receipt for an AI-agent decision (POST /v1/notarize, schema agent_decision). The receipt is Merkle-batched and anchored on Base mainnet; verify offline with @fairseal/verify or at the returned verify_url. Receipts prove provenance (this hash existed at this time), not correctness of the decision. [requires FAIRSEAL_API_KEY or FAIRSEAL_NOTARY_API_KEY]

agent_id.description: Stable identifier of the deciding agent

decided_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the decision; defaults to now

decision_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the decision content (use fairseal_hash_content)

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the decision input (use fairseal_hash_content)

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the full payload being notarized; defaults to decision_hash

name: fairseal_notarize_decision
title: Notarize an agent decision
